Tooltip: Initialization of outlook application used for unread the old OTP mail messages.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutReadMailOTP
Arguments.Tooltip: The amount of time in seconds to wait for activity read all OTP mail messages before an error is thrown. The default value is 180 seconds.

Arguments.Name: TopMailOTP
Arguments.Tooltip: The number of mail messages OTP to be retrieved. The default value is 30.

Arguments.Name: OTP_MailAccount
Arguments.Tooltip: Account outlook for unread the OTP message. If empty/null then used the default account in outlook.

Arguments.Name: OTP_FolderMail
Arguments.Tooltip: Folder in outlook for unread the OTP message.

Arguments.Name: OTP_SubjectMail
Arguments.Tooltip: List of subject email for unread the OTP message.
